text: Federal forces appear to have taken Alamata after three days of heavy fighting in Ethiopia. At least 52 civilians are reported killed; clashes are now reported near Korem, ~100 km south of Mekelle. Independent verification remains limited.

judge.comment: Significant development, hedged appropriately ('appear', 'reported'). Casualty figure is unverified, so a human should look before posting.

factChecks.claim: Federal forces appear to have taken Alamata after three days of heavy fighting
Clashes near Korem, about 100 km south of Mekelle

text: DRC Ebola, as of 30 Sept: 8,116 confirmed cases and 3,924 deaths. 49 new cases and 23 deaths in 24 hours. Cases rose by more than 2,000 during September. Africa CDC has warned of regional spread risk.

judge.comment: Data-first, all figures match the tracker digest and its 30 Sept event.

factChecks.claim: 8,116 confirmed cases, 3,924 deaths as of 30 Sept
49 new cases and 23 deaths in 24 hours
Cases rose by over 2,000 in September
Africa CDC warned of regional spread risk

text: Pennsylvania's 2026 measles death count depends on who is counting: the state reports 5 measles-associated deaths, county coroners confirm 4, and CDC's federal tally shows 3. HHS has questioned whether measles caused or contributed to the deaths.

judge.comment: Contested type never auto-approves. The KPI lists 5/4/3 but its as-of date and exact attribution of each count should be confirmed.

factChecks.source: us-measles-resurgence KPI 'Confirmed measles deaths' / event pa-5th-measles-associated-death-oct01

factChecks.claim: HHS questioned whether measles caused or contributed to the deaths
factChecks.source: us-measles-resurgence disputes (HHS requested details before counting)

text: Pakistan has launched air strikes inside Afghanistan. Afghan officials report women and children were killed. The strikes follow Afghan claims of 28 and 41 fighters killed crossing from Pakistan on 27 and 30 Sept; Islamabad denies ties to the first group.

judge.comment: Casualty claims come from Afghan officials only; the causal link between the border incidents and the strikes is not stated in the data, so wording stays 'follow' chronologically. Needs human review.

factChecks.claim: Pakistan launched air strikes inside Afghanistan
Afghan officials report women and children killed
28 fighters killed crossing from Pakistan (27 Sept)
41 militants killed attempting to cross (30 Sept)
Islamabad denies government ties to the first group
